### Behavioral coverage (per spec)

| Feature | Implementation |
|---|---|
| **Store byte (SB)** | `MemRW==01, Funct3==000`: routes `StoreData[7:0]` to the byte lane selected by `AddrLSB` (0→3); sets `ByteEnable` to `0001/0010/0100/1000` |
| **Store halfword (SH)** | `MemRW==01, Funct3==001`: routes `StoreData[15:0]` to lower/upper halfword via `AddrLSB[1]`; `ByteEnable = 0011 / 1100` |
| **Store word (SW)** | `MemRW==01, Funct3==010`: `WriteData=StoreData`, `ByteEnable=1111` |
| **Load byte (LB)** | `MemRW==10, Funct3==000`: 24-bit sign-extension of addressed byte |
| **Load halfword (LH)** | `MemRW==10, Funct3==001`: 16-bit sign-extension of addressed halfword |
| **Load word (LW)** | `MemRW==10, Funct3==010`: full `ReadData` passthrough |
| **LBU / LHU** | `Funct3==100/101`: zero-extension of addressed byte/halfword |
| **Deterministic defaults** | `MemRW≠01` → `ByteEnable=0, WriteData=0`; `MemRW≠10` → `LoadData=0` |

**Design notes:** All part-selects (`ReadData[…]`, `StoreData[…]`, `AddrLSB[1]`, sign bits) are hoisted to `assign` statements outside `always_comb` blocks, working around Icarus Verilog 12's "constant selects in always_*" limitation. The module is purely combinational and latch-free.
